narrative:
Shelby County has 32,148 registered voters, with 17.9% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 34.9% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 44.5%, a clear Democratic lean of 9.6 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 27.8% of registrants.
